description: Render one of the curated templates by id, optionally overriding the encoded content, colors, or output format/size for this specific call.

additionalConfig.description: Escape hatch for any other QrConfig override the engine accepts.

content.description: Override what the QR encodes. Defaults to the template's built-in content.

outputHeight.description: Output height in pixels (raster) or viewport units (svg). 64-4096.

outputWidth.description: Output width in pixels (raster) or viewport units (svg). 64-4096.

templateId.description: The template id (from qr_list_templates). May be numeric or string (e.g. "luxury-gold").

name: qr_generate_from_template

content.description: The text or URL the QR encodes, when the call set it.

filePath.description: PDF in the stdio package only: local temp file the PDF was written to.

format.description: File format the engine rendered: png, svg, jpg, webp or pdf.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the rendered file (the engine's contentType).

resourceUri.description: PDF on the remote server only: URI of the embedded resource block that carries the file.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the rendered file in bytes, as reported by the engine.

title: Render a QR template
